vanilla_changes.change: After a stem-grown block is harvested, if farmland is around it, the dirt block below is automatically tilled.

editor_notes: Description is terse; exact trigger conditions not verified.
name: Keep My Soil Tilled
summary: When a pumpkin or melon is harvested, the dirt under its stem is re-tilled automatically, so melon and pumpkin farms are not slowly destroyed.
